# trace-sampling-policy

> Tail-based trace sampling policies: ordered keep rules for errors, latency, attributes, trace-id ratio and rate limits, a bounded decision buffer and cached late-span decisions Python package `trysac-trace-sampling-policy`, import name `trace_sampling_policy`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
